dossier.oneLiner: Doctor-led online weight care in Slovakia and Czechia.
dossier.positioning: Weight loss, done properly: medical oversight over quick fixes. A roughly 10-minute online medical questionnaire, a video consultation with a licensed doctor, a prescription (ePredpis in SK) only if the doctor decides it is appropriate, then ongoing check-ins with a care team. Medicine is paid at the pharmacy.

offers.name: Online weight care program
offers.notes: Questionnaire, doctor video consultation, ePrescription if appropriate, care-team follow-up. Price shown in full before payment; cancel anytime.

offers.name: For doctors (B2B)
offers.notes: Partnership program for doctors who want to join the care team.

proof: States consultations are with licensed doctors/physicians

City landing pages for Bratislava, Kosice, Zilina, Praha and Brno
Privacy statement: analytics never use answers to health questions and no tracking runs inside the account
claimsAllowed: Consultation from home, medicine from your local pharmacy
Full price shown before you pay
claimsForbidden: Any prescription medicine name, brand or molecule (Wegovy, Ozempic, Mounjaro, semaglutide, tirzepatide...)
Kilos lost, timeframes or guaranteed outcomes
No need to see a doctor

visual.styleNotes: Soft painterly illustration in greens and warm pinks, plus calm natural-light photography. Doctors are illustrations, never real faces.

gaps: No testimonials or outcomes on site
Prices not visible before the questionnaire
Who can appear on camera (doctor consent)
Pricing: no prices for the first consultation or monthly ongoing care are shown publicly, nor typical pharmacy medicine costs
Czech patients: prescriptions are Slovak and fillable in Slovak pharmacies; how Czech patients obtain and fill prescriptions is unclear
Social proof: no reviews, patient numbers, press, doctor names or credentials are shown; doctor imagery is blurred
Company and regulatory details: legal entity, medical licensing, LegitScript or Meta authorization status not stated (blocks Meta paid ads)
Eligibility criteria (age, BMI, conditions) and what happens if the doctor declines are not answered in the visible content

questions.prompt: Can a patient living in Czechia complete the full program today, from questionnaire to medicine in hand?
questions.why: Czech posts lead the evidence: a busy-parent talking head reached 158,200 views and a Czech anti-miracle-diet app ad has run 97 days. Your prescriptions are Slovak ePredpis, though, and the site does not explain the Czech path.

options.label: Yes, with a prescription filled at a Czech pharmacy
Yes, but the medicine must be picked up in Slovakia
Not yet, Czech patients cannot be served
Unsure, still being clarified

questions.assumption: Not yet. Czech content stays educational with no call to start the program, and conversion content targets Slovakia only.

questions.prompt: If the doctor decides a prescription is not right for someone, what does that patient get?
questions.why: The site does not answer eligibility or what happens after a decline. We must say plainly that the doctor decides (RX2), and the honest answer to 'what if I am declined' is a strong trust message for people who fear being judged.

options.label: A full or partial refund
The consultation stands and they keep care-team lifestyle support
They pay for the consultation only, nothing more
Something else

questions.assumption: We only say the doctor decides what is appropriate for you, and we make no promise about refunds or what follows a decline.

questions.prompt: Can we name your medical lead in text, with title and specialty (no photo), if they give written consent?
questions.why: A Slovak competitor runs ads under 'MUDr. Boris Bajer, PhD' as the page name, which puts credentials up front. Your site blurs doctor imagery and shows no names, and 'Is an online doctor a real doctor?' is your top objection.
questions.assumption: No doctor names. We say 'licensed doctors' and explain the process, which keeps the trust message general.

questions.prompt: Which brand assets can we use right away?
questions.why: Foodvisor's longest-running ad, 97 days, is just one looping mascot animation on a text card, so cheap illustrated formats can last. Your site uses painterly illustrations and illustrated doctors, and we need to know if those files are usable.

options.label: Editable illustration files from the website
Illustrated doctor or care-team characters
A mascot or character we could animate
Licensed natural-light photo library
Brand fonts and social templates
None beyond the logo and colors

questions.assumption: Logo and colors only. We create new illustrations in the website style and avoid any people who could be mistaken for real patients or doctors.

questions.prompt: How light can the tone go on everyday body topics like digestion, hunger or sleep?
questions.why: The best-performing post in the set is a frank stool-type guide linking gut health and weight, 844,900 views. Your voice is calm and clinical, so we need to know whether gentle humor fits.

options.label: Calm and clinical only, no humor
Warm, with gentle humor, never about bodies or weight
Frank and playful on taboo topics is fine

questions.assumption: Warm with gentle humor, never about anyone's body or weight, and no taboo topics.

questions.prompt: Who can reply to comments and questions in Facebook groups in your name?
questions.why: Your main persona is found in Facebook groups, and a winning busy-parent video drew 336 comments from its call-out. Health questions in comments need a safe reply owner before we invite conversation.

options.label: Care team replies, a doctor reviews medical questions
Care team only, with standard answers
Nobody for now, we post without engaging

questions.assumption: Nobody for now. We post education with no comment-bait calls to action and route questions to the questionnaire and FAQ.

questions.prompt: Which of these channels already exist for a.clinic and have been used before?
questions.why: The dossier lists no social accounts or past campaigns, and with a 0 budget the plan depends on organic channels and SEO. Starting from scratch versus an existing audience changes posting volume and where we begin.

options.label: TikTok account
Instagram account
Facebook page
Google Ads tried before
Blog or articles on the site
None yet

questions.assumption: No existing accounts. We start with Instagram, TikTok and SEO on the city and process pages.

plan.summary: Start organic-only in Slovak on three channels: TikTok, Instagram (Reels plus carousels) and SEO on the existing city and process pages. Every working input is an assumption because all questions were skipped. Assuming no LegitScript or Meta authorization, Meta ads are blocked by RX4. Assuming a 0 paid budget, TikTok ads and Google ads wait. Assuming nobody can reply in your name, Facebook groups wait too. The strongest proven signal is Czech and Slovak weight-and-habits TikTok: talking-head and listicle outliers of 18 to 22x (ev_aclinic_119dba_tiktok_mv4chv1045_6575ad, ev_aclinic_119dba_tiktok_mv4chv1046_6575ad, ev_aclinic_119dba_tiktok_mv4chv1056_6575ad). We remake those formats as original, faceless, illustrated education. That content uses only RX5 angles: doctor-led care, the steps plainly explained, the full price shown before payment, and the local pharmacy. It names no medicines (RX1), makes no kg or timeframe promises (RX3), and has no real doctor faces (RX6). Instagram and SEO evidence is thin, so treat those as tests.

channels.rationale: Czech and Slovak weight-and-habits content repeatedly breaks far beyond follower counts on TikTok. Examples are 158.2k views at 21.2x on 7.5k followers (ev_aclinic_119dba_tiktok_mv4chv1045_6575ad), 15.2k at 18.1x on 842 followers for a 'fix the basics' angle (ev_aclinic_119dba_tiktok_mv4chv1046_6575ad), and a saveable 5-4-3-2-1 listicle at 93k views and 22.6x (ev_aclinic_119dba_tiktok_mv4chv1056_6575ad). Assuming no real faces and only logo and colors, we adapt these as illustrated text-card and faceless listicles rather than talking heads, which lowers production fit somewhat. # Ako funguje online starostlivosť o váhu s lekárom

Váha je zdravotná téma a patrí k lekárovi. V a.clinic sa ti venuje licencovaný lekár cez video, bez cestovania a bez sedenia v čakárni. Celý postup je jednoduchý a celú cenu vidíš ešte pred platbou.

## 4 kroky

1. Zdravotný dotazník. Vyplníš ho online, trvá zhruba 10 minút. Lekár ho prejde ešte pred konzultáciou.
2. Video konzultácia s licencovaným lekárom. Porozprávate sa o tvojom zdraví, o tom, čo si už skúšal(a), a o tom, čo potrebuješ. Pýtaj sa na všetko.
3. ePredpis, len ak to lekár uzná za vhodné. O liečbe rozhoduje vždy lekár. Ak predpis vystaví, dostaneš oficiálny slovenský ePredpis, ktorý vyzdvihneš v ktorejkoľvek lekárni na Slovensku.
4. Pravidelné kontroly. Starostlivý tím sa ti ozýva a sleduje, ako sa ti darí. Nie je to jednorazová návšteva.

## Časté otázky

### Je online lekár skutočný lekár?
Áno. Konzultácie vedú licencovaní lekári a celý proces je skontrolovaný lekármi.

### Koľko to stojí?
Celú cenu programu vidíš ešte predtým, než čokoľvek zaplatíš. Ak lekár predpíše liek, platíš ho priamo v lekárni. Zrušiť môžeš kedykoľvek.

### Musím niekam cestovať?
Nie. Konzultácia prebieha cez video z domu a liek si vyzdvihneš vo svojej lekárni, či už ste v Bratislave, Košiciach, Žiline alebo kdekoľvek inde na Slovensku.

### Je to pre mňa vhodné?
To posúdi lekár na základe dotazníka a konzultácie. Lekár rozhodne, čo je pre teba vhodné.

### Čo sa deje s mojimi údajmi?
Analytika nikdy nepoužíva tvoje odpovede na zdravotné otázky a vo vnútri tvojho účtu nebeží žiadne sledovanie.

## Začni dotazníkom
Ak chceš, aby sa tvojej váhe venoval lekár, začni krátkym zdravotným dotazníkom. Služba je momentálne určená pre pacientov na Slovensku.
